ocl:
context AlertRule
inv: (self.ruleId <> '') and (self.alerts->forAll(v | v.acknowledged = true))

context Gateway
inv: (self.isPrimary = true) and (self.connectedEdges->forAll(v | v.memoryMB < 1000))

context Alert
inv: self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null

context Location
inv: (self.device.firmware.checksum <> '') and (self.longitude >= 7 and self.longitude <= 41)

context MaintenanceTicket
inv: (self.otaUpdate.targetDevice = self.device) and (self.status <> '' and self.status.size() > 0)

context DataStream
inv: (self.records->any(x | x.timestamp <> '') <> null) and (self.streamId <> '' and self.streamId.size() > 0)

context AlertRule
inv: self.alerts->exists(x | x.acknowledged <> false)

context Battery
inv: self.healthPct >= 1 and self.healthPct <= 80

context SolarPanel
inv: self.wattPeak >= 26 and self.wattPeak <= 51

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 13 and self.maxLoad <= 54

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 7 and self.maxLoad <= 50

context Location
inv: (self.longitude >= 0) and (self.site.size() >= 9 implies self.site.substring(1, 9) = 'AB')

context SensorNode
inv: (self.sampleRateHz mod 5 = 0) and (self.sensorType <> '' and self.sensorType.size() > 0)

context Alert
inv: (self.message <> null) and (self.createdAt <> '' and self.createdAt.size() > 0)

context Alert
inv: (self.acknowledged = true) and (self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null)

context MaintenanceTicket
inv: (self.otaUpdate.targetDevice = self.device) and (not(self.otaUpdate.targetDevice = self.device))

context CommunicationLink
inv: (self.bandwidthKbps mod 2 = 0) and (not(self.bandwidthKbps mod 2 = 0))

context CommunicationLink
inv: (self.bandwidthKbps >= 42 and self.bandwidthKbps <= 64) and (self.bandwidthKbps < 42)

context Cluster
inv: ((self.gateways->size() > 0) and (self.gateways->collect(x | x.ipAddress)->notEmpty())) and (self.gateways->size() < -5)

context CommunicationLink
inv: (self.isSecure implies self.stream <> null) and (not(self.isSecure implies self.stream <> null))

context EdgeNode
inv: (self.gateway.cluster = self.cluster) and (not(self.gateway.cluster = self.cluster))

context AccessPolicy
inv: ((self.description <> '') and (self.roles->forAll(v | v.roleName <> ''))) and (self.roles->exists(v | not(v.roleName <> '')))

context TelemetryRecord
inv: ((self.stream.device.name <> '') and (self.payload.toLowerCase() = 'test')) and (not((self.stream.device.name <> '') and (self.payload.toLowerCase() = 'test')))

context SensorNode
inv: ((self.metrics->collect(x | x.lastValue)->sum() >= 9) and (self.metrics->one(x | x.lastValue >= 10))) and (not((self.metrics->collect(x | x.lastValue)->sum() >= 9) and (self.metrics->one(x | x.lastValue >= 10))))

context Cluster
inv: ((self.clusterId <> '') and (self.edgeNodes->forAll(v | v.cpuCores > 5))) and (self.edgeNodes->exists(v | not(v.cpuCores > 5)))
